suppress.notes: CVE-2026-116804 (GHSA-cg2g-xh64-v4q7) requires SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES together with RETURN_DOM, RETURN_DOM_FRAGMENT, or IN_PLACE and DOM input carrying a shadow root. File: src/main/webapp/admin/swagger-ui/swagger-ui-bundle.js (matched by SHA-1 below). Swagger UI 5.34.0 uses DOMPurify 3.4.16 only to sanitize Markdown-rendered HTML strings and returns strings. Its sanitizer does not enable any of these options, and its only DOMPurify hook adds rel="noopener noreferrer" to links. This is non-applicability for this exact bundle, not a patched DOMPurify version. Reassess if the bundle, sanitizer options, hooks, or Swagger plugins change. Verified on 2026-10-29 against this checkout, including its final newline. https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/security/advisories/GHSA-cg2g-xh64-v4q7

CVE-2026-116803 requires DOMPurify IN_PLACE mode and an application hook that detaches a parent or sibling subtree. Swagger UI 5.34.0 with DOMPurify 3.4.16 sanitizes Markdown-rendered HTML strings without IN_PLACE. Its only DOMPurify hook sets rel="noopener noreferrer" on links and does not detach nodes. This is non-applicability, not a patched DOMPurify version. Reassess if the bundle, sanitizer options, hooks, or Swagger plugins change. Verified on 2026-10-29 against this checkout, including its final newline. https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/security/advisories/GHSA-mrv2-3pqr-j5jr

CVE-2026-116802 requires PARSER_MEDIA_TYPE="application/xhtml+xml" and an allowlist enabling SVG animation elements and attributeName. Swagger UI 5.34.0 with DOMPurify 3.4.16 sanitizes Markdown-rendered HTML strings using the default text/html parser. Its sanitizer only sets ADD_ATTR=["target"], FORBID_TAGS, ALLOW_DATA_ATTR, and FORBID_ATTR; it does not enable XHTML or SVG animation. File: src/main/webapp/admin/swagger-ui/swagger-ui-bundle.js (matched by SHA-1). This is non-applicability for this exact bundle, not a patched DOMPurify version. Reassess if the bundle, parser mode, allowlists, hooks, or Swagger plugins change. Verified on 2026-10-29 against this checkout, including its final newline. https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/security/advisories/GHSA-c6gr-qvv4-5v3f

CVE-2026-104828 affects HTMLWriterFilter when serializing textarea/title text. The reviewed CMS uses Neko through wjdaisydiff in DocTools.getHtmlDiff(). NekoHtmlParser creates a SAXParser and forwards events to the DaisyDiff content handler; the result is serialized through HtmlSaxDiffOutput and SAX/XSL transformers. Inspection of the resolved dependencies and local DaisyDiff JAR confirms that this path does not instantiate or configure HTMLWriterFilter. This is non-applicability in the reviewed integration, not a patched Neko library or accepted residual risk. Reassess when Neko/DaisyDiff versions, HTML output handling or custom integrations change, especially if HTMLWriterFilter is introduced. Verified on 2026-10-29. Reference: https://github.com/HtmlUnit/htmlunit-neko/security/advisories/GHSA-39xg-prhf-8785
